- 9105: created May 20, due date June 3 (fails on created_at = June 3)

- Step 5: After further reasoning, executes PUT /tasks/9105 and sets due_at to 2027-07-15.
- Step 6: Final answer: updated 9105, mentions the discrepancy, mentions the year assumption.

Is there any possibility of "presented" instead of "incorrect"? No — it wrote to 9105, which is a decoy. incorrect.

Artifact check: no ignored filter, no unreadable field (created_at was visible in the task listing response), write was not rejected, test is not defective — the request clearly says "created on June 3" and neither decoy was created on June 3. So no artifact.

Verdict: incorrect, exposed facts ["A:Task.created_at"], mechanism saw-mismatch-accepted.

It was an absence test; the correct behavior was to report that no task was created on June 3 and change nothing.
